paper.title_en: Shadows and gravitational perturbations of black bounces
paper.abstract_en: We investigate axial gravitational perturbations and shadow formation in black-bounce geometries supported by anisotropic fluids within general relativity. Two distinct classes of solutions are analyzed: a symmetric Simpson--Visser-like black bounce and an asymmetric deformation of the Reissner--Nordström metric, which can feature either a bounded interior region or an unbounded wormhole-like extension. Our findings indicate that configurations with horizons, whether symmetric or asymmetric, exhibit single-barrier effective potentials and quasinormal frequencies nearly indistinguishable from those of standard black holes. In contrast, horizonless symmetric configurations may develop multiple potential barriers, giving rise to gravitational-wave echoes whose amplitude and separation depend sensitively on the bounce parameter $a$ and the density parameter $ρ_0$. Horizonless asymmetric solutions, on the other hand, exhibit regularized effective potentials that do not produce echoes and remain phenomenologically close to the Reissner--Nordström case. From the optical perspective, both classes of solutions with horizons exhibit a single relevant photon sphere and shadow profiles nearly indistinguishable from those of their black-hole counterparts, while horizonless symmetric configurations can sustain multiple photon rings. Horizonless asymmetric configurations may instead support either a single photon ring or none. Finally, we recover the standard eikonal correspondence between quasinormal modes and the instability of circular null geodesics for configurations with horizons. For horizonless geometries, however, the emergence of multiple potential barriers prevents a straightforward extension of this relation, although the strong similarity between the wave and optical sectors suggests that a meaningful phenomenological correspondence may still persist.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在广义相对论框架下系统研究了黑洞反弹几何的轴向引力扰动、准正规模、引力波回声与阴影，涵盖有效势垒结构、光子环及eikonal对应关系，理论深度与方法细节较充分，主题与索引收录方向契合。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞反弹的阴影与引力扰动
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由各向异性流体支撑的黑洞反弹几何中的轴向引力扰动和阴影形成，这些工作是在广义相对论框架内进行的。我们分析了两类不同的解：一类是对称的Simpson--Visser型黑洞反弹，另一类是对Reissner--Nordström度规的非对称变形，后者可能具有有界内部区域或无界的类虫洞延展。我们的发现表明，具有视界的位形，无论对称与否，都表现出单势垒有效势以及几乎与标准黑洞无法区分的准正频率。相反，无事件视界的对称位形可能发展出多个势垒，从而产生引力波回声，其振幅和间隔敏感地依赖于反弹参数$a$和密度参数$\rho_0$。另一方面，无事件视界的非对称解表现出正则化的有效势，不产生回声，并且在现象学上仍与Reissner--Nordström情形接近。从光学角度来看，两类具有视界的解都表现出单一的相关光子球和几乎与其黑洞对应物无法区分的阴影轮廓，而无事件视界的对称位形则可以维持多个光子环。无事件视界的非对称位形则可能支持单个光子环或者没有光子环。最后，对于具有视界的位形，我们恢复了准正模式与圆形零测地线不稳定性之间的标准eikonal对应关系。然而，对于无事件视界的几何，多个势垒的出现阻碍了这一关系的直接推广，尽管波动和光学部门之间的强烈相似性表明，有意义的唯象对应关系可能仍然存在。
